sources.title: Swift Bonsai 2 | UkisAI
sources.snippet: Swift brings UkisAI's reasoning-efficiency work to Prism ML's Ternary Bonsai 2 27B. The Swift correction is merged into two complete GGUF files: 1-bit at 5.947 GB and 2-bit at 7.206 GB. This is an experimental research release.
